rows.name: factory_raw
rows.source:
#define TOKEN SHOW
#xcommand MAKE => #xcommand TOKEN \<x> => OUT(\<x>)
MAKE
TOKEN New
SHOW New

rows.name: factory_capture
rows.source:
#define VALUE alpha
#xcommand MAKE <!n!> => #xcommand <n> \<x> => OUT(\<x>)
MAKE VALUE
VALUE New
alpha New

rows.name: generated_define
rows.source:
#define ALIAS END
#xcommand FIRST => #define ALIAS NEXT ; ALIAS New
#xcommand NEXT <x> => OUT(<x>)
FIRST

rows.name: alias_chain
rows.source:
#define A B
#define B END
#xcommand END <x> => OUT(<x>)
A New

rows.name: alias_temporal
rows.source:
#define ALIAS FIRST
#xcommand FIRST <x> => OUT(<x>)
#xcommand SECOND <x> => RESULT(<x>)
ALIAS New
#undef ALIAS
#define ALIAS SECOND
ALIAS Again
